items.title: Gore Street Energy Storage chair Angus Gordon Lennox to resign
items.summary: Angus Gordon Lennox is stepping down as chair and non-executive director of the Gore Street Energy Storage trust after a tenure of one year.

items.title: Crawford, MSIG UK and Howden-backed Novark announce senior appointments
items.summary: Insurance Business UK reports senior leadership changes spanning operations, finance and insurance-linked securities roles across Crawford & Company, MSIG UK and Novark.

items.title: Testudo insures AI agents of New York law firm Crosby
items.summary: Specialist AI liability insurer Testudo has provided standalone policy protection backed by Lloyd's of London to New York-based AI-native law firm Crosby.

items.title: PERILS raises final loss estimate for Australian storms to AUD 3.13bn
items.summary: Property damage accounts for the vast majority of insured losses from the November 2025 severe convective storm event.

items.title: Industry bodies publish report on tax charges related to pension liberation schemes
items.summary: A collaborative report by the Pension Scams Industry Group, Arc Pensions Law, Dalriada and Standard Life examines the unresolved tax burden facing victims of historic pension liberation scams.

items.title: LIIBA warns against assuming soft insurance market will persist through 2027
items.summary: Christopher Croft highlights geopolitical risks and economic pressures that could disrupt commercial pricing and capacity.
